subject: Coordinating rotating demo windows across US/EU/APAC — action items and final schedule
messages:
From: Ravi Kumar <ravi.kumar@oriontech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Sokolov <marta.sokolov@oriontech.com>, Ben Holt <ben.holt@acmecloud.ca>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 22:10:00 +0000
Subject: Request: multi-window demo + security & procurement availability

Hi Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks again for the quick intro call earlier. We want to run a 90-minute technical demo and a short procurement/security sync for two evaluation tracks: OrionTech (APAC-heavy) and AcmeCloud (EU/NA). The challenge: our engineering team is split across India (Bangalore), Germany, and a small US East team. Procurement and security can only join certain windows next week.

Can you propose a plan that:
- gives a live walk-through for engineering (60 mins) and a procurement/security 30-min slot the same day;
- rotates times so no single team is always late;
- includes an on-call handoff doc and quick escalation path if we hit data-classification questions.

People to include on scheduling: Marta Sokolov (procurement), Ben Holt (security), Ravi (eng lead), Elise (AcmeCloud contact — we looped her in for the joint evaluation).

Appreciate a few concrete windows (US-friendly, EU-friendly, APAC-friendly) and a calendar invite we can accept.

Thanks,
Ravi

--
Ravi Kumar
Principal Engineer, OrionTech

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 02:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: multi-window demo + security & procurement availability

Ravi — thanks for the clear ask. Below is a proposal that balances engineering deep-dive time with procurement/security slots and rotates the anchor across regions over three consecutive days.

Proposal (each day = single 90-min session + 15-min optional + rotation note):
- Day 1 (Tue 5 Dec): 03:00–04:30 UTC — favors APAC lead attendance (Bangalore evening), EU morning, US late night; procurement/security: 04:30–05:00 UTC.
- Day 2 (Wed 6 Dec): 12:00–13:30 UTC — favors EU; procurement/security: 13:30–14:00 UTC.
- Day 3 (Thu 7 Dec): 19:00–20:30 UTC — favors US; procurement/security: 20:30–21:00 UTC.

Rotation hand-off: we suggest the presenter role rotates (Marissa / Dylan / Jonas) so the regional nuance is preserved. I'll attach an initial hand-off spreadsheet for who presents what and who owns follow-ups.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda + slide owners), rotation-hand-off-table.xlsx (owner matrix), soc2-access-request-form.pdf (for Ben).

If that looks good I can post calendar invites for the three sessions and tag the hosts. Also: Marta — can you confirm which two procurement approvers must be present and if they need a separate PII/data-handling slide?

-Jonas

--

Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: multi-window demo + security & procurement availability

Adding Dylan (solutions engineer) and Aisha (sales manager) so we have coverage for the three demo anchors. Dylan — please review the agenda and call out any deep-dive backend topics you want to reserve for the EU slot.

Quick asks / notes:
- Dylan: could you prepare a short 10-min section on inference runtime KPIs (latency under continuous batching) for Day 2?
- Ben: we included the SOC2 request form as an attachment; if you need additional evidence (network diagrams, encryption-at-rest certs) flag it and we'll surface it ahead of Day 1.
- Marta: if procurement can only join one of the EU or US-favored slots, tell us which and we'll prioritize that day for contract/terms review.

I'll create the three calendar invites after Jonas confirms owners.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Marta Sokolov <marta.sokolov@oriontech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Holt <ben.holt@acmecloud.ca>, Ravi Kumar <ravi.kumar@oriontech.com>, Elise Tremblay <elise.tremblay@acmecloud.ca>
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 10:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: multi-window demo + security & procurement availability

Thanks for the plan. Procurement availability constraints:
- Primary approver: Marta Sokolov (me) — available on Wed 6 Dec 12:00–14:30 UTC (preferred).
- Secondary approver: Nikhil Rao (external) — only available on Thu 7 Dec 19:00–21:00 UTC.

Security note from Ben: he can join either Day 1 or Day 2 but prefers Day 2 for the SOC2 discussion.

Given that, can you swap Day 2 and Day 3 presenters so procurement has a full slot on Wed 6 Dec? If we must keep the rotation order, make sure the procurement chunk gets the longer term/contract slide earlier in the session.

Also — one ask: can you provide a short (1 page) non-technical summary for procurement to review ahead of Day 2? That will speed up the contract conversation.

Thanks,
Marta

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Sokolov <marta.sokolov@oriontech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 18:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: multi-window demo + security & procurement availability — final schedule + invites

Perfect — appreciate the constraints and the quick responses. Final plan below (I updated the rotation so procurement gets Wed 6 Dec):

Final schedule (all invites sent — links in calendar):
- Wed 6 Dec 12:00–13:30 UTC — Day 1 (EU-anchored) — Presenters: Marissa (overview), Dylan (runtime KPIs), Jonas (ops + roadmap). Procurement block 13:30–14:00 UTC (Marta + Nikhil).
- Thu 7 Dec 03:00–04:30 UTC — Day 2 (APAC-anchored) — Presenters: Dylan (deep-dive), Jonas (integration), Marissa (customer stories). Procurement optional 04:30–05:00 UTC.
- Fri 8 Dec 19:00–20:30 UTC — Day 3 (US-anchored) — Presenters: Jonas (business + pricing), Marissa (demo wrap), Dylan (Q&A). Procurement optional 20:30–21:00 UTC.

Action items (owners):
- Jonas: post calendar invites + owner tags (done). HubSpot deal updated: ORION-ACME-2028-11 (link included).
- Marissa: non-technical procurement one-pager (shared Drive) — ETA: Fri 1 Dec EOD.
- Dylan: prepare runtime KPIs slide for Wed 6 Dec and confirm any network IPs we should allow for test traffic.
- Ben: confirm SOC2 evidence list by Mon 3 Dec.

Notes on logistics:
- Each session will include a 10-minute buffer at the end for handoff notes in the shared spreadsheet. That sheet also includes a point-of-contact mapping so the on-call presenter knows who to escalate to if we hit a network/permissions issue.
- Attachments sent with this thread: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, rotation-hand-off-table.xlsx, soc2-access-request-form.pdf.

If there are no further objections, we'll proceed with the invites and the shared Drive links. Thanks everyone — looking forward to the sessions.

-Jonas
